label: Variation
text: BI.O.A1.4 Variation. Mutation is a change in sequence: point, indel, copy-number or chromosomal. Its fitness effect is a later claim (BI.O.A4), not part of the definition. Recombination generates new allele combinations. The gene has two definitions, molecular (transcribed region) and classical (unit of inheritance); a sentence must say which.

warrant.standard: Replicated cross or edit; sequencing with stated error rate; independent lab confirmation
warrant.defeaters: Contamination; off-target edits; annotation error; linkage mistaken for causation
